company_name: Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. Common Shares
title: Metalla Announces Voting Results From Annual General Meeting And Investment From Sandeep Singh
summary: Vancouver, British Columbia: Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. (“Metalla” or the “Company”) (NYSE American: MTA) (TSXV: MTA) is pleased to announce the voting results for its annual general meeting of shareholders held on June 23, 2026 (the “Meeting”) where all director nominations and other items recommended by the board of directors of the Company (the “Board”) were approved.
